// xss-0001 (priority 50, block): XSS probe
if ($req.path == "/search" && (strings.match($query.q, "(?i)<script"))) {
    if ($ctx.project == "trade-web") {
        ctx.report("waf.block", "xss-0001");
        resp.sendJson(403, {code: "WAF_BLOCKED", ruleId: "xss-0001"});
        return true;
    } else {
        ctx.report("waf.log", "xss-0001");
    }
}

return true;
